summary: DAY revision preserves the independent same-cycle falsification work and applies the current advisory readiness rule. No batch thesis was falsified outright, and the documented concentration, policy, cyclicality, backlog, dilution and integration risks are present-day risk factors/falsifiers rather than unresolved red-team evidence contradictions. All 12 companies are therefore advisory ready_for_chief from this lane; Chief and underwriting may still keep individual companies blocked for separate methodology-required evidence gaps.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Neutron, backlog and M&A create compounded execution/capital risk, but no current falsification or unresolved red-team contradiction prevents reproducible risk treatment.
unknowns: Neutron cash need/backlog cancellation economics remain explicit.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Customer concentration is the dominant cliff risk; it is evidenced and can be scored conservatively rather than treated as a reason for perpetual red-team non-readiness.
Platform/customer concentration and warrant/control complexity remain material but are already identified; no red-team contradiction blocks Chief review.
unknowns: True end-customer concentration and future warrant vesting.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Export controls, custom silicon and hyperscaler concentration are first-class downside paths, but they are explicit risk scenarios rather than missing red-team acquisition.
Repeat deployment/software economics remain the key falsifier; current evidence does not invalidate the thesis.
Custom-AI concentration plus VMware tail risk can create discontinuous downside, but the risk is documented and not a red-team reproducibility failure.
unknowns: Program-level customer shares and refinancing tail.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Taiwan geographic concentration remains the principal non-diversifiable fragility; it is an explicit scenario, not an unresolved contradiction.
Export policy, customer capex and High-NA ROI are the relevant falsifiers; no present-day contradiction invalidates Chief review.
unknowns: Future China/export mix and High-NA ROI.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: SoftBank/control, related parties, customer concentration and production-silicon channel conflict are material; they are identified and can be treated conservatively.
unknowns: AGI CPU economics and RISC-V trajectory.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Peak-cycle/HBM scarcity mean reversion is the core failure analogue; the uncertainty is future-state risk, not missing red-team methodology input.
Cloud-titan concentration and proprietary/white-box substitution remain key downside paths but are sufficiently explicit for Chief review.
unknowns: Current customer shares and substitution rate.

perCompanyCoverage.challenge: Backlog conversion plus UIG integration/capital allocation are material failure paths; current evidence does not falsify the thesis or create a red-team contradiction.

materialFindings.finding: All 12 active-batch companies are advisory ready_for_chief from the adversarial lane: material failure modes are documented, none is presently falsified, and no unresolved red-team contradiction prevents reproducible conservative treatment.
The batch remains highly exposed to one shared hyperscaler-AI-capex regime, so apparent ticker diversification materially overstates factor diversification.
Underwriting still reports at least one company-methodology gate for each batch name; that is a separate lane result and does not convert documented red-team falsifiers into red-team blockers.

contradictions: Strong growth can coexist with severe concentration/common-shock fragility.
A plausible future falsifier is not equivalent to a present-day evidence contradiction.
unknowns: Comparable customer-concentration percentages remain incomplete across the batch.
Comparable downside impact from one shared AI-capex reset is not yet canonically modeled.

peerRequests.request: Continue exact required-input closure without reopening already-documented red-team risk scenarios as generic research blockers.
Use this lane's ready_for_chief=true as advisory red-team clearance only; preserve independent underwriting/source gates where they remain real.

accuracyDebates.reason: Prevents every plausible downside scenario from becoming perpetual non-readiness while keeping risks visible for scoring and Chief adjudication.
